subject: Branded lounge activation & content track request
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@pulsesummit.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Branded lounge activation + content track request

Hi Sofia,

Really great to meet last week — excited at the possibility of Redwood running a branded lounge at PulseSummit. Attached is the latest lounge floorplan (lounge_floorplan_v3.pdf) with rough sightlines and the demo pod footprint. A few items for your team to consider:

- Branded furniture footprint: 20'x30' (two demo pods + seating area)
- Dedicated power run behind the main couch (15A 120V)
- Two standing banners and one hanging loop above the lounge
- 6 staff exhibitor passes + 2 VIP backstage passes for the content session
- Ability to host a 30–40 minute "spotlight" session in the adjacent content track (we can carve a 30-minute 2:00pm slot on Day 2)
- Networking email blast inclusion (one dedicated mention + logo in 3 weekly emails prior to the event)

Can you confirm what deliverables you’ll want from Redwood (files, banners, AV specs, headshots/bios), and whether the content session should be promotional or a product-focused technical talk? Also include any procurement/PO timelines so I can lock the space.

If you want to do a short addendum to the sponsorship agreement, I can send a templated clause for the content track and streaming rights.

Thanks — attaching the floorplan now.

Best,
Elena Torres
Events Lead, PulseSummit
Elena@pulsesummit.com
PulseSummit — Feb 23–25, 2027

Attachment: lounge_floorplan_v3.pdf

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@pulsesummit.com>
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Branded lounge activation + content track request

Elena — thanks for the plan and the floorplan. We're interested in the lounge + the adjacent 30-minute session on Day 2, but need to confirm a few internal constraints first. High-level deliverables we will provide:

- Branded lounge build: 2 demo pods (lockable cabinets), one 6-ft literature table, two standing banners (provided by Redwood design), and branded couch throw.
- Promo: promo_creatives (assets for the email blast and stage slides) — attached as redwood_promo_creatives_v1.zip.
- Staffing: we'll send 4 onsite staff per day; need 6 exhibitor badges and 2 backstage passes as noted.
- Content session: we'd prefer a technical talk focused on inference at scale (no customer PII live demos). We'll need a 30-minute slot with a 20-min presentation + 10-min Q&A. We require pre-approval of slides and a speaker intro in advance.

Questions for you:
1) Can the session be livestreamed/recorded for post-event distribution?
2) Do you provide a mic + livestream link and a house projection feed to capture the talk?
3) What's the deadline for final artwork for the lobby signage and the email blast?

If possible please share the exact copy specs for the banners (bleed, size) and an updated cost for adding the content session and a prominent floor position near the main aisle. We'll also need a short sponsorship addendum to route through our procurement.

Thanks — attaching our creative pack.

Sofia Ivanova
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

Attachment: redwood_promo_creatives_v1.zip

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Branded lounge activation + content track request

Sofia — copied you on technical constraints we need to confirm with Pulse: see notes below and attached checklist (venue_technical_checklist.pdf).

- Power: 15A at the back of the lounge is fine but we need a labeled run and a distribution strip; order must be placed 10 business days before load-in. No three-phase on that run.
- AV: house projection and livestream are available from the venue for the content track session, but live-streaming of the lounge itself is restricted unless approved by venue AV (clearance takes 72 hours).
- Content rules: no live ingestion of customer data on stage; recorded demos must use synthetic/test data. Slides must be submitted 48 hours prior to the session for pre-check.
- Build: vendor can access floor for build Monday (day before) 08:00–20:00; full strike by 22:00 on final day. If we need branded arch or hanging signage we must file for rigging 15 days prior.

Available 30-minute session times: Day 2 at 14:00 (preferred), Day 2 at 11:30 (alternative), Day 3 at 10:00 (backup). If Elena can confirm 14:00 we can lock the adjacent room.

I'll follow up with a short annotated floorplan that marks the power drop and demo pod locations.

Logan Wright
Events Operations | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai

Attachment: venue_technical_checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@pulsesummit.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 11:16:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Branded lounge activation + content track request

Elena — appreciate the details. A couple of asks from Redwood's side to finalize commercials and benefits:

1) We can confirm the lounge at the proposed footprint and the 14:00 Day 2 slot as long as the sponsor package includes: 3 pre-event email mentions (as you suggested), a logo on the main stage screens during keynote introductions (two rotations per day), and a 150-word featured paragraph in the event guide.

2) In exchange for elevated placement (main aisle sightline + hanging loop) we are proposing a modest fee adjustment. Alternatively, if Pulse can include Redwood in the main stage intro ( verbal mention ), we can accept the original fee. Which option works for you?

3) Procurement: we have a standard sponsorship addendum — I've drafted suggested redlines and attached sponsorship_addendum_draft_redlines.pdf. Please review and let us know if your legal team has any issues.

If Pulse can confirm streaming rights for the session (we'd like to post the recording), and confirm the three email blast spots, we can route a PO next week. Elena — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that will move things faster.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0246

Attachment: sponsorship_addendum_draft_redlines.pdf
